coverage: Main Rummage process only; sampled preview helpers had neither heaptrack environment nor library mappings. GPU allocations and helper allocations are not included.
peak_category_caveat: Rounded merged stack totals from heaptrack_print; not additive disjoint accounting. Requested payload bytes differ from mallinfo2 allocation chunks.
outstanding_at_end: Largest stacks belong to Fontconfig configuration, GLdispatch (59.58 KB), GLib and Pixman initialization. These can be process-lifetime globals; outstanding-at-exit is not proof of an unreachable leak.
interpretation: This run supports bounded loaded-catalog/preview memory over three repeated passes. It does not reproduce the reported roughly 1 GB RSS and cannot rule out longer-run, different-source, helper or GPU issues. JSON catalog representation is a material optimization target, distinct from a leak.

completion.driver_issue: Sampling wrapper raised Main process disappeared after the app finished; heaptrack attempted automatic GUI startup. The finalized trace parses successfully. Do not count wrapper invocation as passing or use profiled timing.

filename_privacy: Analysis inspected for original photo paths and /home paths; none found. Benchmark paths replaced with labels. Raw application log remains private because it can contain filenames.
